Description
American Gold Eagle bullion coins are among the most highly collective and sought-after coins in the world. The 1/10 oz Gold American Eagle coin is the
US Mint
’
s authorized 1/10 oz gold coin. The 1/10 oz Gold American Eagle coin is the smallest of the four American Gold Eagle coins, and it’s a simple and affordable way for people of all types and budgets to experience all the benefits of gold collecting.
These coins are NGC MS70 graded first release version, encapsulated by NGC. Each coin has its own serial number which can be checked on the NGC website for authenticity.
The 1/10 oz American Gold Eagle coin is the official bullion coin of the United States and the weight and purity of this gold coin are guaranteed by the United States Government. US Gold Eagle coins are 22 Karat gold which gives them a more durable surface. The 1/10 oz US Gold Eagle coin can be used in contracts in the USA based on their $5 face value although they are traded based on the market rate for gold.
The 1/10 oz Gold American Eagle coins are among the most
gold bullion coins
popular in the world due to their high quality, low premium, and their limited mintage. The combination of excellent quality, low premium, and limited mintage makes the 1/10 oz Gold American Eagle coin an item that can be had at a fraction of the cost of other bullion coins.
With its low mintage, the American Gold Eagle coins are a hot commodity in the market.
The gold coin is highly tradable and is quite popular in the market. All American Gold Eagle coins are IRA approved.
Design of 1/10 oz Gold American Eagle Coin
The obverse of the 1/10 oz American Gold Eagle coin features the design of iconic Liberty designed by the Augustus Saint – Gaudens with a torch in her right hand and an olive branch in her left, striding forward on the mountain top with rays of the sun behind her and a backdrop of the Capitol building. The word “LIBERTY” and the year of the mintage of the coin can also be found on the obverse side of the gold coin.
Reverse: Portrait with an American bald eagle, a design by Jennie Norris in 2021. You can also see the inscriptions “UNITED STATES OF AMERICA”, “E PLURIBUS UNUM”, and “IN GOD WE TRUST”, along with the weight, purity, and denomination on the reverse side of the American Eagle Gold Coin.
These coins are minted in 2024, however the mint marks may be from different mints.
